about: Rows of the RSGB 2026 plan that ohsradio/plans/rsgb_2026.py does not carry, transcribed from the PDF itself on 09/10/2026 (openhamshack docs/research/BANDPLAN-GAPS.md, re-read against the PDF's text layer). tools/export_ohscore.py drops the generated rows inside each 'drop' span, adds 'segments', and closes the export's own gaps inside 'fills'. Each row's src names the PDF page and that band's own effective-from date, since the plan has no single date.

drop.why: 13 cm re-transcribed from p.25: 2321-2322 MHz is 20 kHz, not 25 kHz, and the local beacons split the narrow band
9 cm re-transcribed from p.26 to add the local beacons
6 cm re-transcribed from p.27: EME in the narrow band, and its beacons
3 cm satellite row re-cited from p.28 with the rest of the band

unplanned.why: RSGB 2026 p.25 gives no UK usage for 2310.5-2311 MHz
RSGB 2026 p.25 gives no UK usage for 2315-2320 MHz (the IARU column says only 'national band plans')
RSGB 2026 p.26 gives no UK usage between the beacons and 3401 MHz
RSGB 2026 p.28 prints no row for 10125-10225 MHz, which is not in the UK licence

advisories.text: RSGB 2026 Note-1 recommends 472-475 kHz for CW only, at most 200 Hz wide: this signal is outside that recommendation
advisories.src: R1 p.7 Note-1 (630 m; a usage recommendation, so a warning, never a refusal)
